K:letter-identification / K-229.first: Do the first row together. Point to the letter in the box and say its name. Move your finger along the row and stop at each letter: "Is this one the same? Look closely." Circle the ones that match. Tell the children that some letters look almost alike, so they have to look closely.

K:beginning-sounds / K-221.first: Name all the pictures on the page together, so that everyone uses the same word for each. On the page for everyone they are bus, hat, sun, pig, apple, dog, ball, and fish. Do the first one: say the word slowly and ask, "What is the first sound?" and then, "Which letter makes that sound?" Write the letter on the board; the children write it on the page.

K:rhyme / K-232.first: Name all the pictures together, so that everyone uses the same words. Say the first picture on the left, then say it with each picture on the right: "boat, frog… boat, goat." Ask which pair sounds the same at the end. Draw that line together. For your own reference, the pairs on the page for everyone are boat and goat, bed and sled, dog and frog, cat and hat, bee and tree.

K:sound-position / K-226.first: Name all the pictures together. On the page for everyone they are fox, sun, bus, book, bed, drum, pig, and cat. Do one together: say the word slowly and hold the last sound: "bus-sss." Ask, "What is the last sound? Which letter makes that sound?" Write the letter on the board. Remind the children that this page asks for the end of the word, not the beginning.

K:count-syllables / K-233.first: Clap a few children's names together: "Ma-ri-a, three claps." Name all the pictures on the page together. On the page for everyone they are airplane (2), ambulance (3), banana (3), dog (1), sun (1), cat (1), apron (2), and acorn (2). Clap the first picture's word together and write the number on the board.

K:cvc-build / K-231.first: Name all the pictures together. On the page for everyone they are frog, fox, bus, sun, star, and ball. Do the first word on the board: say the word slowly and ask, "What is the first sound? The next sound? The last sound?" Write a letter for each sound and read the word together.

K:cvc-build / K-224.first: Name all the pictures together. On the page for everyone they are fig, dog, pig, leg, fox, hat, cat, and bus. Do the first word on the board: say the word slowly, point to each letter as you say its sound, and stop at the empty space. Ask, "Which sound belongs here? Which letter makes it?" Write it in and read the word together.

1:rhyming / G1-343.first: Name the big pictures and the small pictures together, so that everyone uses the same words. On the page for everyone the big pictures are clock, dog, and cat, and the small ones are bat, frog, sock, hat, rock, and log. Take the first small picture and say its word with each big picture in turn. Ask which pair sounds the same at the end. Write the word on the board under that big picture; the children write it on a line.

1:phoneme-boxes / G1-312.first: Name all the pictures together. On the page for everyone they are panda, koala, bison, zebra, tiger, and seal. Do the first word on the board: draw the boxes, say the word slowly, and tap a box for each sound. Write the letter or letters for each sound in its box. Count the sounds together.
